Logic Explained: The Philosophy of Arguments

Released Aug 29, 2025, 25 min

Play Logic Explained: The Philosophy of Arguments on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

Arguments are more than just mere disagreement--they are how we establish reasons for things and justify our beliefs. And the study of building arguments is logic. In this (long!) video, I give an overview of logic. What is it? What are arguments? How can you find good ones? How can you become a logician? And what does this have to do with Artificial Intelligence? The answers to all these questions await!
